```lean
theorem lg_target {Γ : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)} [Γ.HasDetPlusMinusOne] (hΓ : ∃ h ∈ Γ.strictPeriods, 0 < h) {a b : ℤ} {f : ModularForm Γ a} {g : ModularForm Γ b} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) : f.mul g ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  contrapose! h
  intro hz
  have hz' : ∃ z ∈ 𝕜⁺, f z * g z = 0 :=
    ⟨z, hz, hz⟩
  cases hz' with z hz
  have hz'' : f z * g z = 0 :=
    hz
  rw [mul_eq_zero_iff] at hz''
  cases hz'' with hfx hgx
  exact hf (λ w hw, hfx (λ hz', hz' ▸ h w hw) (hz' := hz))
  exact hg (λ w hw, hgx (λ hz', hz' ▸ h w hw) (hz' := hz))
```
